title: SCOA: archived adult social care question sheet
description: Use the predecessor’s eight aspects, 71 assessment questions, and 88 constraints and enablers, with local notes and /100 self-assessment scores.
introduction: The strategic commissioning options appraisal was the adult social care predecessor to the broader Commissioning Compass. This archive preserves its question sheet for comparison and use with judgement.
instructions: Give your place an instinctive score on how you are doing in terms of each 8 aspects of commissioning, then revisit this after working through the questions and aspects /100
Score your place on each question, but do not simply average your results – look at the overall pattern you are seeing.
Factors in place that constrain or enable

Which of these factors most hold back your ability to work in this space? Which most support you? Think about both your level of understanding of the factors, and the factors themselves. The aspects that hold you back or enable you to work on this aspect of commissioning will be picked up in your commissioning development plan.

source.title: Self-Assessment Questions for 8 Aspects
source.note: The generic wording is transcribed from the undated predecessor document Self-Assessment Questions for 8 Aspects. This is an archive source edition, not a claim that it is the latest sector-specific tool or a complete migration of the teaching material. It preserves 71 questions, 88 factors, and /100 score fields. No numerical score-band labels or three-factor limit are added, because neither appears in this sheet. Some policy references belong to the historical source. Saving, perspectives, decisions, and reviews are additions to the online edition.

What did we learn about how the system behaves?
